description: This file contains implementation of socket-based communication for exec approvals and command execution within a macOS application. It defines data structures, socket handling, request/response protocols, user prompting via NSAlert, and executor handling for remote command approval and execution.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsPromptServer
classes.description: Singleton managing the startup and shutdown of the exec approvals socket server.

methods.name: requestDecision
methods.description: Asynchronously requests a decision from the socket at specified path with a timeout.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the exec approvals socket server.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Displays a user prompt for command approval, returning the decision.

methods.name: buildAccessoryView
methods.description: Builds a Swift NSView presenting command and context details in the user prompt.

methods.name: buildContext
methods.description: Creates an execution approval context based on the request data.

methods.name: persistAllowlistEntry
methods.description: Records an 'allow always' decision for a specific command pattern.

methods.name: ensureScreenRecordingAccess
methods.description: Checks and requests permission for screen recording if needed.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously, returning the result.

methods.name: errorResponse
methods.description: Constructs an error response for command execution failures.
